infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SmartBus uses your location to show your position on the transit map, identify your nearest bus stop, and provide accurate arrival estimates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SmartBus requires background location while driving active trips so students and administrators receive real-time bus arrival coordinates even when the phone is locked or in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: SmartBus requires background location while driving active trips to broadcast coordinates.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SmartBus requires background location while driving active trips so students and administrators receive real-time bus arrival coordinates even when the phone is locked or in the background.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: SmartBus requires background location while driving active trips to share live transit coordinates with students.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SmartBus uses your location to display your position and broadcast transit coordinates during active trips.
